battle.name: 赤壁之戰
battle.brief: 建安十三年冬，曹操大軍南下，舟艦首尾相接泊在長江北岸烏林，與隔江的孫劉聯軍相持。黃蓋詐降，十艘蒙衝斗艦載薪灌油、趁東南風衝入曹營，火烈風猛，燒盡北船。卡面羅馬短劍未曾踏上長江，但它那套持盾掩護、以刺突收官的近戰邏輯，正是漢軍環首刀配大盾在火攻後短兵相接時的寫照。

kit.name: 羅馬短劍
kit.history: 刺劍不是用來揮砍的。短兵相接靠的是盾的邊緣和刺突的節奏。

countries: 赤壁之戰是建安十三年（208）十一月曹操南征與孫權、劉備聯軍在長江中游赤壁一線的一場決戰。曹操一方是挾天子以令諸侯的北方政權：主力為中樞直接掌握的河南、河北、關中兵與騎兵，另收劉表荊州降軍降卒，舟師多為荊州水軍原有的蒙衝、斗艦，總指揮只有曹操一人，諸軍分屬曹仁、曹洪、張遼、徐晃等將領，水陸調度皆出其帳下；曹仁受命留鎮江陵，許都由荀彧等留守，曹操未留後手，一旦野戰失利便只能全軍北撤。孫權一方是江東政權：孫權徵兵得精兵三萬餘，以周瑜為都督、程普為中軍將，黃蓋、韓當、蔣欽、呂蒙、潘璋、丁奉等各部，配水軍與蒙衝斗艦，魯肅居中贊畫，張昭一系則力主降曹。劉備一方是失去荊州的客軍：關羽、張飛、趙雲部眾自當陽長坂潰散後走夏口，與劉表長子、江夏太守劉琦會合，得兵一萬餘人，諸葛亮以使臣身分赴柴桑促成結盟。雙方主力隔江相望，曹操居北岸烏林，孫劉在南岸赤壁，地形、水文與天候決定了後面所有的勝負手。
countriesEn: Red Cliffs was a decisive engagement fought in the eleventh month of Jian'an 13 (208) between Cao Cao's southward expedition and an allied army of Sun Quan and Liu Bei along the middle reaches of the Yangtze. Cao Cao's side was the northern regime that held the imperial court in its hands. Its core consisted of infantry and cavalry drawn from Henan, Hebei and Guanzhong, augmented by the surrendered troops of Liu Biao's Jing Province, and its navy was largely inherited from the same command, so that the war-craft at its disposal were the Jingzhou mengchong and doujian. Command was concentrated in one man: Cao Cao himself, with the various contingents distributed among generals such as Cao Ren, Cao Hong, Zhang Liao and Xu Huang, and every movement on land and water issued from his tent. Cao Ren was ordered to hold Jiangling, the capital at Xu was watched by Xun Yu and others, and Cao Cao kept no second line of his own, which meant that once a field battle was lost there was nothing to do but withdraw north in full. Sun Quan's side was the Jiangdong state. He mustered some thirty thousand picked troops, appointed Zhou Yu to command the entire force with Cheng Pu leading the central army, and distributed the contingents of Huang Gai, Han Dang, Jiang Qin, Lü Meng, Pan Zhang and Ding Feng among the squadrons, backed by river warships. Lu Su sat at the centre as his chief adviser, while the Zhang Zhao party pressed hard for surrender. Liu Bei came as a refugee force stripped of Jingzhou. After the rout at Changban in Dangyang, Guan Yu, Zhang Fei and Zhao Yun brought the survivors to Xiakou, joined the elder son of Liu Biao and Administrator of Jiangxia, Liu Qi, and recovered a force of more than ten thousand men; Zhuge Liang travelled to Chaisang as an envoy to cement that alliance. The two masses stood facing each other across the river, Cao Cao on the north bank at Wulin, the allies on the south bank at Red Cliffs, and the terrain, the currents and the weather decided everything that followed.
people: 赤壁的關鍵人物分屬三邊。曹操是全場唯一有權決定全軍進退的人：他見孫權不肯降，便留曹仁鎮江陵，自率主力順流東下，在烏林下寨；火起之後他放棄水軍，改由陸路退卻，途中在華容一帶遇上泥濘，士卒多失足，賴左右衝開道路方得脫身，龐德隨曹洪殿後收攏散兵，張遼與徐晃整頓部伍退往北方。孫權是另一個決定者：面對曹操的勸降信與春水方生一類的恫嚇，他一度猶豫，經魯肅、周瑜力陳利害，遂拔刀斫前奏案，宣布死戰，並授權周瑜全權指揮水軍。魯肅是主張抗曹最堅決、也最早看清曹操弱點的人；周瑜是全戰役的技術核心，他判定曹軍舟艦首尾相接、北方士卒不習水戰，提出火攻並親自選船編組。黃蓋是火攻的執行者，他以年長之身自請為詐降之使，偽造歸順文書；關羽、張飛、趙雲護著劉備的家眷與部眾自長坂脫身，於夏口重整旗鼓，後奉命北取襄陽、樊城。曹仁是曹操留在荊州的支點，他死守江陵約一年，替曹操爭取到重新部署的時間；荀彧等在許都力主南征，認為孫權、劉備無力抵抗，卻低估了江東的決心。至於演義中的蔣幹反間、蔡瑁張允被斬，屬小說情節，史料無據。
peopleEn: The decisive figures of Red Cliffs belonged to three camps. Cao Cao was the only man with the authority to decide the movement of the entire army. When Sun Quan refused to surrender, he left Cao Ren to garrison Jiangling, took the bulk of his force down the river in a downstream run and pitched camp at Wulin. Once the fire rose, he abandoned his fleet, turned to the roads on land, and during the withdrawal his troops were mired near Huarong, where the soldiers slipped and fell and only the cavalry around the commander could force a way through; Pang De with Cao Hong brought up the rear and gathered stragglers, while Zhang Liao and Xu Huang reformed their units and fell back north. Sun Quan was the other decision-maker. Faced with Cao Cao's letter of persuasion and threats about spring floods, he hesitated, until Lu Su and Zhou Yu set out the case against surrender; he then cut the desk in front of him with his sword, declared that there would be no surrender, and handed Zhou Yu full command of the naval force. Lu Su was the man who argued most firmly against submission and who first saw clearly where Cao Cao's strength was hollow. Zhou Yu was the technical core of the whole affair: he judged that Cao Cao's ships lay bow to stern, that northern soldiers were unused to fighting on water, proposed a fire attack, and personally selected and organised the vessels for it. Huang Gai carried the fire attack out, volunteering in old age to go as the envoy of feigned surrender and forging the letter of submission. Guan Yu, Zhang Fei and Zhao Yun brought Liu Bei's household and surviving soldiers away from Changban, rallied them at Xiakou, and were later sent north to take Xiangyang and Fan. Cao Ren was the hinge Cao Cao left in Jingzhou; he held Jiangling for about a year, buying time for the northern side to redeploy. At the capital, Xun Yu and others had urged the southern campaign on the assumption that Sun Quan and Liu Bei could not resist, and they underestimated the resolve in Jiangdong. The schemes in which Jiang Gan plays the turncoat and Cai Mao and Zhang Yun are executed belong to the novel rather than to the historical record.
kits: 卡面這件羅馬短劍並不屬於長江戰場的裝備序列：公元208年的羅馬帝國正處五賢帝末與塞維魯王朝初，第十二軍團與其他軍團駐紮萊茵、多瑙與不列顛，與赤壁沒有任何直接關係，它在此處的意義是提供一個技術坐標。羅馬短劍是典型的刺擊型直身短兵，長約六十公分，刃身厚實、雙面開鋒而尖端銳利，幾乎不用來揮砍，必須配大盾才發揮威力：持盾手先以盾緣頂開敵刃並擠壓身位，持劍手再以劍尖完成最後幾步，密集隊形裏盾牌與劍互相掩護，缺一不可。漢末的近戰邏輯與此高度相似：曹軍與孫軍的步卒以長矛、戟、鈹、弩列陣抵禦，進入短兵距離後靠環首刀與雙刃直劍刺砍，漢劍多無護手、柄短、重心靠前，同樣是刺擊為主而不靠劈砍的取向，並配大盾、梟盾等遮蔽正面。不過漢末水陸大戰的真正關鍵裝備是船：陳壽《三國志·周瑜傳》記周瑜乃取蒙衝斗艦百餘艘，載燥荻枯柴、灌油其中，裹以帷幕、上建牙旗；曹操的舟艦首尾相接以資穩定，北方士卒不習水戰；弩機、標槍、投石車與運糧的船隊構成後勤。演義裡的方天畫戟、青龍偃月刀、雌雄雙股劍在史料並無記載，不應當作漢末的制式裝備。
kitsEn: The gladius on the card does not belong to the equipment inventory of the Yangtze battlefield. In AD 208 the Roman empire was passing from the Five Good Emperors into the early Severan age, with the twelfth legion and its sisters stationed on the Rhine, the Danube and in Britain, and Red Cliffs was no part of that world; the weapon's function here is to supply a technical coordinate. A gladius is a straight thrusting sword of about sixty centimetres, with a thick blade, edges on both sides and a sharp point, meant almost never to be swung, and it only works in company with the large oval shield: the shielded man first opens a gap with the rim of his scutum and crowds the enemy back, and the swordsman finishes the business with the point, each covering the other in a close formation, neither of the two usable alone. Han late-era close combat followed a very similar logic. Infantry of both Cao Cao's and Sun Quan's armies met an advance with long spears, halberds, ji, and crossbows, and once the range closed they cut and stabbed with ring-pommel sabres and double-edged straight jians, Han swords being generally without a handguard, short in the grip and weighted forward, again a thrusting-first and not a chopping doctrine, and they were used with large shields and light wicker shields to cover the front of the body. The true decisive equipment of a late Han water battle, however, was the ship. Chen Shou's Records of the Three Kingdoms, in the biography of Zhou Yu, records that he took a hundred or more mengchong and doujian, loaded them with dry reeds and firewood, poured oil into them, wrapped them in awnings and raised toothed banners on them. Cao Cao's vessels were lashed bow to stern so that they would hold steady, because northern soldiers had never fought on water; crossbows, javelins, stone-throwers and the grain barges formed the logistics. The fangtian huaji, the green dragon crescent blade and the twin-tined sword of the novel have no basis in the historical record and should not be treated as standard late Han equipment.
tactics: 赤壁的戰術可以分三段。第一段是對峙：曹軍舟師自江陵順流而下，泊於北岸烏林，聯軍列陣南岸赤壁，曹操以新勝之氣屢遣使挑戰，聯軍按兵不動，只等風。第二段是火攻：周瑜主張火攻的根據是操軍船艦首尾相接、可燒而走也，黃蓋以詐降為掩護，選定蒙衝斗艦十艘為前鋒，裝載易燃物料、建牙旗、張帷幕，隱約其進攻之意；東南風起時，十船同時揚帆直衝曹軍，餘船依次跟進，火烈風猛，燒盡北舟，火焰延及岸上營落。曹操的水軍在相繫的舟船與浮動的營帳之間失去退路，北方士卒不習水戰，慌亂中多被火焚或落水。第三段是追擊與殘局：周瑜率軍攻擊烏林營落，曹操棄舟登岸，與諸將由華容道退卻，孫劉兩軍分路追擊；曹仁所守江陵被周瑜大軍圍困約一年，曹仁閉城固守，城中糧食將盡，援軍在外又被擊退，最後才北撤荊州。火攻之所以成功，關鍵不在火藥，而在風向、船型與對方把全軍綁在一條船上的佈局。
tacticsEn: The tactics of Red Cliffs fall into three stages. The first was the standoff. Cao Cao's fleet came down the river from Jiangling and anchored at Wulin on the north bank, while the allies deployed on the south bank at Red Cliffs; riding on the momentum of his recent victories Cao Cao sent envoys to provoke an engagement, but the allies held their ground and simply waited for the wind. The second stage was the fire attack. Zhou Yu grounded his proposal in the fact that Cao Cao's ships lay bow to stern and could be burned, and Huang Gai used a feigned surrender as cover, selecting ten mengchong and doujian as the spearhead, loading them with combustible material, raising toothed banners and spreading awnings to suggest an approach in submission; when the southeast wind rose the ten ships set sail at once and drove straight into Cao Cao's line, the rest following in order, and the fire, driven by the gale, consumed the northern fleet and reached the shore encampments. Cao Cao's troops, tied together on their vessels and among floating camp structures, had nowhere to retreat to, and northern soldiers unused to the water were burned or drowned as they thrashed. The third stage was the pursuit and the aftermath: Zhou Yu's men struck the camp at Wulin, Cao Cao abandoned his ships and went ashore, and the commanders withdrew along the Huarong road while the Sun-Liu forces pursued in two columns. Jiangling, held by Cao Ren, was then invested by Zhou Yu's army for about a year; Cao Ren shut the city and held out, the food in the city running short, relief columns defeated outside, and only at last did he withdraw from Jingzhou. What made the fire attack work was not the incendiary material but the direction of the wind, the shape of the ships and the fact that the enemy had bound his entire army onto a single line.
data: 可核對的數字有限，但足以看出規模與消耗。時間線是：建安十三年七月曹操南征荊州，八月劉表死、劉琮舉州降，九月劉備自當陽長坂走夏口、諸葛亮使柴桑，十月曹操書勸降、孫權拔刀斫案決戰，十一月至十二月在赤壁交火，曹操於建安十四年正月前引軍北還。兵力上，曹操在致孫權書中自稱兵眾以百萬計，《三國志》裴注所引《江表傳》等書記載聯軍為數萬之眾，學界一般認為曹操實際可用兵力約在數十萬上下，其中相當部分是剛受降的荊州兵；聯軍方面，周瑜所部孫軍約三萬，劉備與劉琦部合計一萬餘至兩萬餘，雙方差距並沒有演義渲染的那麼懸殊。火攻一次投入蒙衝斗艦百餘艘，其中十艘為先鋒；曹操退兵時《江表傳》稱其舟艦為火所燒略盡，軍資大部淪陷。《三國志·武帝紀》又記敗後會大疫流行、吏士多死者，說明水陸惡戰加上疫病，消耗並非只發生在那一夜的江面上。距離上，舟隊自江陵至赤壁江程約數百里，逆流行軍的時間成本，構成曹操必須速戰速決的客觀壓力。
dataEn: The verifiable numbers are limited, but they are enough to show the scale of the affair and what it consumed. The timeline runs: in the seventh month of Jian'an 13 Cao Cao invaded Jingzhou; in the eighth month Liu Biao died and Liu Cong surrendered the province; in the ninth month Liu Bei was driven from Changban in Dangyang to Xiakou and Zhuge Liang went to Chaisang; in the tenth month Cao Cao sent his letter of persuasion and Sun Quan cut the desk with his sword to decide on war; the fighting at Red Cliffs took place in the eleventh and twelfth months, and Cao Cao led his army north before the first month of Jian'an 14. On strength, Cao Cao claimed in his letter to Sun Quan a host of a million, whereas the Records of the Three Kingdoms and its commentary citing the Ji Biao Zhuan describe the allied force as a few tens of thousands; the general scholarly view is that Cao Cao had perhaps some hundreds of thousands at his disposal, a substantial share of them recently surrendered Jingzhou troops. On the allied side Zhou Yu commanded about thirty thousand Sun troops, and Liu Bei's and Liu Qi's men together numbered a little over ten thousand to something over twenty thousand, so the gap between the two sides was nothing like the exaggeration of the novel. The fire attack committed a hundred or more mengchong and doujian at once, ten of them as the spearhead; on the withdrawal the Ji Biao Zhuan records that Cao Cao's ships were burned almost completely and his supplies were largely lost. The Records of the Three Kingdoms, in the annals of the emperor, adds that after the defeat a great epidemic broke out and many of the soldiers and officers died, which shows that the cost was not confined to a single night on the river. As for distance, the run from Jiangling to Red Cliffs was several hundred li of river, and the time cost of fighting against the current put objective pressure on Cao Cao to force a quick decision.
cause: 打起來的原因有三層。最外層是吞併：曹操於建安十三年春已平河北、定關中、滅袁氏，是當時天下唯一的強權，南征荊州本是統一全國的下一步，劉表死、劉琮降後，曹操不戰而得荊州，並把降軍、降卒與水軍一併收編，順流東下直指江東，他並不打算與孫權、劉備平分天下。第二層是劉備這個變數：劉備佔據荊州多年，又曾借劉表之兵北伐，曹操視其為久必生亂的隱患，故不容其喘息；當陽長坂的一戰打崩了劉備的部隊，也讓曹操以為劉備已不足為慮，於是放心地把大軍壓到江邊。第三層是孫權自身的選擇：曹操兵威已及於江夏，孫權內部以張昭為主者主張迎降，理由是江東可降而不可鬥；魯肅、周瑜則指出曹操挾天子而令諸侯，遠征而來，新疲之眾必不能持久，且北方將士不習水戰，士氣與技術皆不占優。諸葛亮出使柴桑，把劉備一方的處境與聯盟的可行性講明，才讓孫權下定決心。東吳決定抵抗的那一刻，戰爭就已經無法迴避。
causeEn: There were three layers behind the fighting. The outermost was absorption. By the spring of Jian'an 13 Cao Cao had pacified Hebei, settled Guanzhong and destroyed the Yuan clan, and was the only real power left in the empire, so the march into Jingzhou was the next step towards unifying the country; when Liu Biao died and Liu Cong surrendered, Cao Cao took Jingzhou without a battle, incorporated its troops, its surrendered levies and its navy wholesale, and ran down the river straight at Jiangdong, with no intention of sharing the realm with Sun Quan or Liu Bei. The second layer was Liu Bei as a variable. Liu Bei had held Jingzhou for years and had borrowed Liu Biao's troops to campaign north, and Cao Cao treated him as a standing danger that could not be left to recover; the battle at Dangyang and Changban broke Liu Bei's army and let Cao Cao conclude that Liu Bei was no longer a threat, so he could safely press his masses down to the river. The third layer was Sun Quan's own decision. Cao Cao's military reach already touched Jiangxia, and within Jiangdong the Zhang Zhao party urged that they receive the submission, on the grounds that Jiangdong might surrender but must not fight; Lu Su and Zhou Yu argued instead that Cao Cao, who held the emperor and commanded the lords, had come too far with an exhausted army, and that northern soldiers could not fight on water, so neither morale nor technique was on his side. Zhuge Liang's mission to Chaisang explained the position of Liu Bei's side and the practicality of the alliance, and only then did Sun Quan make up his mind. The moment Jiangdong decided to resist, the war could no longer be avoided.
impact: 赤壁的結果改變了之後一百六十年的中國格局。曹操失去南進的窗口，統一事業延後，最終由曹丕建立曹魏、孫權建吳、劉備建蜀漢，三家並立成為中國歷史上的一個新階段的起點；曹操本人至建安二十四年仍未能再有效南下，荊州成為孫劉爭奪的核心。劉備借聯軍之名取得南郡與荊州牧名號，在江陵一帶站住腳跟，卻也從此與孫權形成不能兼容的權力結構，兩家的裂痕最終在建安二十年關羽襲取江陵時全面爆發。技術上，這是火攻第一次大規模改寫水陸戰爭的結果，也讓江東保住了人口、財富與手工業的完整，成為後來吳國抵禦北方、經營江南的基礎。文化上，《三國演義》把赤壁寫成以火破敵的戰役，於是借東風、草船借箭、華容道義釋曹操成為華人熟悉的意象；同時也提醒讀者，演義中的空城計、多餘的兵器形制多屬小說，與陳壽《三國志》的記載並不重合，讀史與讀小說必須分開。至於卡面這柄羅馬短劍，它在這場戰役裡沒有任何角色，但它與漢末環首刀同屬刺擊為主、必須配盾的技術路線，提醒我們公元前二世紀到公元二世紀，歐亞兩端的短兵體系各自成熟而互不相通。
impactEn: The outcome of Red Cliffs changed the shape of China for the hundred and sixty years that followed. Cao Cao lost the window for a southern advance and his unification was postponed; in the end Cao Pi founded Wei, Sun Quan founded Wu and Liu Bei founded Shu-Han, and the three states standing together mark the opening of a new stage in Chinese history. Cao Cao himself never mounted an effective second southern campaign even as late as Jian'an 24, and Jingzhou became the core contested by Sun and Liu. Taking the name of the allied army, Liu Bei obtained the commandery of Nanjun and the title of Inspector of Jingzhou, took his stand around Jiangling, and at the same time formed with Sun Quan a structure of power that the two could not share; the rift between them finally broke out completely when Guan Yu seized Jiangling in Jian'an 20. In technical terms this was the first time a fire attack rewrote a water battle on a large scale, and it allowed Jiangdong to keep its population, wealth and handicraft intact, which became the base on which Wu later resisted the north and developed the Yangtze delta. In cultural terms the Romance of the Three Kingdoms turned Red Cliffs into a set-piece fought with fire, and the borrowing of the east wind, the straw boats and the release of Cao Cao at Huarong became images every Chinese reader knows; at the same time it warns the reader that devices such as the empty-city stratagem and the fanciful weapon forms of the novel are inventions, and do not match what Chen Shou recorded, so history and fiction must be kept apart. As for the gladius on the card, it played no part in this battle at all, but it and the late Han ring-pommel sabre belong to the same school of thrusting-first close combat that cannot be separated from the shield, which is a reminder that between the second century BC and the second century AD the short-weapon systems at the two ends of Eurasia matured separately and never met.
result: 打點完：曹操水軍在赤壁江面被火攻重創，舟艦大部焚毀，士卒死傷慘重，軍心崩潰，他放棄水軍改走陸路，經華容道退卻，途中因道路泥濘而屢受阻，軍中又遇疫病，吏士多死，遂引軍北還，只留曹仁鎮江陵。曹仁在江陵被周瑜大軍圍困約一年，靠閉城固守與援軍在外周旋，城中糧食將盡，最後北撤荊州，孫劉聯軍於是取得南郡。劉備表劉琦為荊州刺史，劉琦死後自領荊州，孫權則與劉備結為姻親，聯盟表面維持而暗地較勁。周瑜在戰後上疏孫權，建議取蜀、並兵張漢中，據其上流以圖天下，惜未及行而建安十五年病卒，年三十六。陳壽《三國志·劉備傳》記曹公敗於赤壁，一句話就為這場戰爭定了性：北方統一的嘗試在此折戟，長江以南的並立格局正式成形，後世稱其為三國之始。
resultEn: The outcome was this. Cao Cao's fleet was gutted by the fire attack on the river at Red Cliffs, most of his ships burned, the soldiers killed and wounded in numbers, and the morale of the army collapsed; he gave up his navy, took to the roads on foot and withdrew along the Huarong route, where the mud repeatedly blocked him, while an epidemic ran through the camp and many soldiers and officers died, so that he led the army back north and left only Cao Ren to hold Jiangling. Cao Ren was then invested at Jiangling by Zhou Yu's army for about a year; he held the city shut and fought the relief columns outside, the food in the city running short, until at last he withdrew from Jingzhou, and the Sun-Liu alliance thus obtained Nanjun. Liu Bei petitioned for Liu Qi to be appointed Inspector of Jingzhou, and when Liu Qi died took that office himself; Sun Quan sealed the alliance by marrying into Liu Bei's household, so that the union was maintained on the surface while the two competed beneath it. After the battle Zhou Yu memorialised Sun Quan with the plan to take Shu, to move the armies against Hanzhong and to hold the upper reaches in order to secure the realm, but he died of illness in Jian'an 15 before it could be carried out, at the age of thirty-six. Chen Shou's Records of the Three Kingdoms, in the biography of Liu Bei, records that Cao Cao was defeated at Red Cliffs; one line settles the verdict of the whole affair. The northern attempt at unification broke there, the pattern of parallel states south of the Yangtze took shape, and later generations called it the beginning of the Three Kingdoms.
